quotes.text: The rubric is constructed once and applied unchanged to every model evaluated on that case
It is driven by DeepSeek-V4-Pro under the system prompt given in full in Supplementary Section 5.5.4

contradiction_quotes.text: the framework imposes no fixed maximum number of turns

parsed.rationale: Rubrics are frozen and scenario data are fixed, but the patient, environment and evaluator agents are live API LLMs with no snapshot or version pin beyond a family name. Candidate contradiction: the paper reports no turn cap while the example config sets max_total_turns to 12 (unverified whether it is enforced). The example config also defaults all simulator agents to gpt-5.5, unlike the paper's DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
